title: Private Open-Air Minibus Sightseeing Tour in Nashville
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You can rent our guided, open-air bus, for your private group of up to 12 people for a 2-hr time block. These tours are completely customizable to your preference, below are our 3 most common tours. Want something else contact us directly and we’ll create an experience just for you and your guests. If you want to do a mural tour, brewery tour, or party bus tour we got you covered. Or better yet make it a combination of all the best sites Nashville has to offer. 

Xperience Nashville is a great way to host a relationship building experience for your employees or guests while getting to see the local sights of Nashville. We can fully customize your tour to your preferences ensuring everyone has a great time!

Our private tours are available from the Hours of 10:00am-6:00pm. Please contact us directly to schedule a time.
